The '''tanzanite fang''' is obtained from killing [[Zulrah]]. It can be used with a [[chisel]] to create the [[toxic blowpipe (empty)]], requiring level 78 [[Fletching]] and granting 120 experience.

Players can dismantle the fang to receive 20,000 [[Zulrah's scales]], resulting in a loss of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Zulrah's scales|20000}}-{{GEP|Tanzanite fang}}|c}}.
